notes.title: Final announcement
notes.content:
Dear players, Long time no read! We hope you had a lovely start to 2025.

We wanted to say a big thank you for playing Calibre 10 and for showing it so much love and care over the years. We're still very proud of what we created and happy it got such good feedback and a great community behind it.

[b]The last update to the game came out a while ago, but we wanted to put out a final post to conclude Calibre 10's journey. We will take the game out of early access, and there will not be any more updates.[/b]

[b]We are eternally grateful[/b] for the generous input from you, our players, and want to thank you again for playing Calibre 10.

The game is not going to be taken off of Steam, so you can still buy and play it if you would like.

Onto the next chapter!

Talk soon, The team at Bongfish

notes.title: Alpha #3 Update Available
notes.content:
[h1]Attention to all DRIVES and SHOOTERS[/h1]

[h1]The latest update is featuring new tracks, new vehicles and turrets[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b]INCREASED LEVEL CAP[/b] to 3, featuring the rail and hover turret and new race tracks with shootable short-cut gates.
 [*][b]NEW VEHICLES[/b] - the Matador Heavy Truck and Maurador Trophy Truck are available. Both vehicles are bold and heavy compared to the more leightweight Kloss and Buggy.
 [*][b]NEW INGAME COMMUNICATION PANEL[/b] for enhanced team coms.
 [*][b]NEW WEAPON[/b]: Introducing ''The Health Gun',  Shooters can infuse Health to Drivers.
 [*][b]CLAN FEATURE[/b] preview: each pair of players can assign a TEAM NAME and LOGO, from there team points will be accumulated for this team and can be ranked on the global TEAM leaderboard.
(Hint: Choose the ALIENWARE team to get access to the ALIENWARE branded buggy)
[/list]

See you on the race tracks!

notes.title: Alpha #2 Preview is online!
notes.content:
We are proud providing a first glimpse of the upcoming updates.
An early progression system allows to unlock new content and capabilities.

List of new content
[list]
[*]The AX off-road buggy playing his strengths on dirt-road sections of the tracks.
[*]The Rail Turret introducing strafing-abilities to keep up with the pack of racers.
[*]A brand new race track featuring shootable gates opening short cut sections.
[*]The spectator mode accessible from the lobby.
[*]A console for a first implementation of text chats.
[*]Many small fixes and more...
[/list]

Thanks to the great feedback from early adopters, the team had been able fixing a lot of bugs and further polishing the game.

Have fun driving & shooting,
Bongfish Team

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Calibre 10 Racing Series
notes.content:
Calibre 10 Racing Series is Now Available on Steam Early Access!
Present day takes place at an undisclosed time in the near future. A major catastrophe has disrupted the global economy to the point where there is only one televised sporting event left in the world, The C10 Racing Series.   ‘C10 Racing Series’ is the largest and most popular event in the world sponsored by the world’s mega corporations. Stock prices are determined by the outcome of races for these sponsors. Driver and Shooters are well paid heros for billions of viewers around the world. The spectacle of the races are legendary and take place at locations all around the globe.

  • 4 Teams of 2. One Driver and One Shooter. Each Team battling it out to be the first to cross the finish line.

  • Drivers go flat-out pushing horsepower limits behind the wheel of high-concept super cars in an all out blitz over tarmac and dirt. Shooters push firepower limits in high-tech military grade turrets, covering their driver, taking out opposing vehicles and turrets, jockeying for the most advantages turret positions around the track.

  • Team-work, intensity, vehicle countermeasures like flares and chaff to fend off incoming fire from opposing team turrets, a steady aim and on-track power-ups that provide an upgradeable edge for Shooter weaponry are needed to capture the checkered flag and championship glory.
